Liam (AM): New POC request from EuroBank. They need EU-only processing for compliance reviewers. Can we give a short packet: subproc list, routing config example, and a note on fail behavior?
Rina (SE): Yes. Hosted endpoints can be pinned to eu-west / eu-central. For strict EU-only we set routing: pin=[eu-west,eu-central], fallback=none -> requests get 429/503 if no capacity.
Liam (AM): Theyexpect ~25 r/s with 100-200 tokens. No BYOK for POC.
Asha (Legal): I'll produce subproc CSV and a paragraph stating control-plane telemetry may be processed in US; no payloads/PII leave EU.
Omar (SRE): Note: small routing metadata may hit our global control plane. We can keep audit logs & stored artifacts in EU-only buckets for the POC. Cost uplift for pinned routing ~12-16%.
Rina (SE): Sample snippet we can share:
```
routing_policy:
  mode: geo_pin
  regions: [eu-west1, eu-central1]
  fallback: none
  telemetry: minimal
```
Liam (AM): Deadline: customer wants docs by EOD tomorrow for compliance. Can we hit that?
Omar (SRE): I can deliver network path + cost note by EOD.
Asha (Legal): Subproc CSV and SOW blurb (fail-closed acceptance) by tomorrow.
ticket-bot: PRESALES-9001 created. Owner: Omar. SLA: 48h.
Liam (AM): Great — I'll package runbook, subproc list, cost uplift and send to EuroBank once uploaded. Will update when signed. :thumbsup:
